item.title: S1E1: Peter and Debbie Moore, Owners of Santa Barbara Sky FC - The SB Effect
item.description: About The Santa Barbara EffectThe Santa Barbara Effect is a podcast dedicated to celebrating the entrepreneurial spirit, cultural richness, and unique stories of the Santa Barbara community. Each episode features conversations with local innovators, business leaders, and community members who are making a difference.

item.title: From the Archives: Interview with Joe Pasternack - The SB Effect
